module: Class of a co-driver call (pacenote) of a race path: a positioned sphere (manually or on a navgraph node) with a normal, a note text and the id of an associated segment. The module returns a factory: require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/race/pacenote')(path, name, forceId). It is used by the race editor and for path serialization.
notes: setNormal: when normal is nil, the default value vec3(0,1,0) is set but the function continues and calls normal:length() on nil: Lua error (no return).
setNavgraph uses self.navRadiusScale and inside reads self.hasNormal, two fields never initialized in init (unlike pathnode): setNavgraph fails on an existing node, inside only tests the sphere.
intersectCorners ignores hasNormal: it always uses the normal's plane.
onSerialize does not save the mode: deserialization always recreates the note in manual mode.

C.desc: Co-driver call. Fields: path, id, name, pos (vec3), normal (vec3, default (0,1,0)), radius, note (text), segment (id, -1 if none), sortOrder (999999 by default), mode, navgraphName.

init.desc: Constructor: assigns the id (forceId or path:getNextUniqueIdentifier()), the default name "Pacenote <id>", the null position, the empty note and the segment -1.

setNormal.desc: Sets the call's normal if its length exceeds 0.9 (it is then normalized).

normal.desc: Direction; nil causes an error (see notes).

setManual.desc: Switches to manual mode with the given position, radius and normal (forgets the navgraph node name).

setNavgraph.desc: Switches to navgraph mode: takes position and radius from a road map node, or from fallback if the node does not exist.

fallback.desc: {pos, radius} used if the node is absent.

inside.desc: Indicates whether a point is inside the call's sphere (and on the correct side of the normal if hasNormal).

intersectCorners.desc: Tests whether one of the segments connecting a vehicle's corners (fromCorners[i] to toCorners[i]) crosses the call's plane inside the sphere.

returns.desc: Smallest crossing parameter t (0..1), math.huge otherwise.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the call: name, pos, radius, normal, oldId, note, segment.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the call (manual mode) from serialized data; converts the segment id with oldIdMap.

drawDebug.desc: Draws the sphere, the text (note, or "(name)" if empty) and the normal's arrows with debugDrawer.
